class Counter:
    count = 0
    def __init__(self, tag):
        self.tag = tag
        Counter.count += 1
    def bump(self):
        Counter.count += 10
        return Counter.count
a = Counter('a')
print(Counter.count)
b = Counter('b')
c = Counter('c')
print(a.bump(), b.count, c.count)
